title: Comparison Page
content: Build comparison page for products or plans. Header: items being compared with images/names. Sticky header: keeps product names visible while scrolling. Feature rows: grouped by category. Values: text, checkmarks, or ratings. Highlight winner: best value per row. Add/remove items. Print comparison. Mobile: horizontal scroll or card-based.

variants.simple: Create product or plan comparison table with features.
variants.detailed: Build comparison page for products or plans. Header: items being compared with images/names. Sticky header: keeps product names visible while scrolling. Feature rows: grouped by category. Values: text, checkmarks, or ratings. Highlight winner: best value per row. Add/remove items. Print comparison. Mobile: horizontal scroll or card-based.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive comparison page for products, plans, or services. Page header: "Compare [Products/Plans]" title, "Compare up to 4 items" note. Add items: if less than max, show "Add to Compare" button opening product search/picker. Selected items header: sticky top-0 bg-white z-10, flex with product columns. Each column: product image (w-24 h-24 object-contain), name (font-semibold), price, rating stars, "View Details" link, remove X button. First column: fixed width for feature names. Comparison table: w-full. Feature categories: collapsible sections with category headers (bg-gray-100 font-semibold py-2). Feature rows: border-b hover:bg-gray-50. Row structure: feature name cell (sticky left-0 bg-white w-64, text-sm font-medium), product value cells (text-center). Value types: Boolean (Check icon green or X icon gray), Text (string value), Rating (stars or numeric), Image (small product image), Link (clickable text). Highlight best: optionally bold or badge the winning value per row (lowest price, highest rating). "Differences only" toggle: filter to show only rows where values differ. Quick verdict: summary section with "Best for [use case]: [Product]" recommendations. Action row: CTA buttons per product ("Buy Now", "Learn More"). Export: "Print Comparison" and "Share" buttons. Print styles: clean table format optimized for print. Empty columns: if less than max items, show "Add Item" placeholder cards. Responsive: horizontal scroll table wrapper on mobile, or transform to card-based comparison (each product as card with features listed). Sticky first column: feature names visible while scrolling horizontally. Alternating row colors: even:bg-gray-50 for readability. Collapse long content: long text values truncated with tooltip or "View more". Loading: skeleton columns while loading product data. URL state: compared items in URL for sharing (/compare?items=1,2,3). Accessibility: proper table headers, comparison context clear for screen readers.
